faqs.question: Do you design outdoor spaces as well as interiors?
faqs.answer: Yes. We plan the layout and choose furniture, outdoor fabrics, rugs, lighting and planters for patios, decks and courtyards, then style the space. Your contractor, builder or landscaper builds the structure.

faqs.question: How much does outdoor living design cost?
faqs.answer: It depends on the scope, from a single consultation to full-service design. We quote after the discovery call. Our guide to [what an interior designer costs in Portland](/blog/interior-designer-cost-portland) explains how designers usually charge.

faqs.question: How far should a wood fire pit be from the house?
faqs.answer: The Oregon Fire Code says recreational fires shall not be conducted within 25 feet of a structure or combustible material. Gas fireplaces and fire tables follow their own installation rules. Check with your contractor and local fire department before we plan seating around one.

faqs.question: When does a deck need a railing?
faqs.answer: Oregon's 2023 residential code requires guards where a walking surface is more than 30 inches above the grade below, and they must be at least 36 inches tall. Your contractor confirms the details with the permit; we plan the furniture around them.

faqs.question: What outdoor furniture holds up to Portland rain?
faqs.answer: Pieces made for outdoor use, cushions that dry quickly, and a covered spot or storage for the wettest months. We choose fabrics and finishes for how exposed your space actually is.
